About Daily Letter

A straightforward daily word puzzle

Daily Letter is a free browser-based word game. The goal is to identify one hidden five-letter word in no more than six valid guesses. A new puzzle is provided each day.

What the game provides

Players receive color clues after each guess, can request a limited hint, and may create an optional Player ID to save statistics, streaks and leaderboard results.

What the game does not provide

Daily Letter does not offer cash prizes, gambling, sweepstakes or guaranteed rewards. Game results are for entertainment only.

Advertising

Any third-party promotion is clearly labeled “Advertisement.” An advertisement’s destination and offer are controlled by the advertiser and must be reviewed before publication.
